text:
noah (mktg): Hey team — quick creative brief for the webinar/inbound push. Need three deliverables by Wed EOD: 1) Signup funnel illustration (single-diagram, mobile+desktop crops) showing steps: Landing → Short form → Confirmation modal → Thank you email. 2) Email hero image (600x200 px) that reads well at 320px width. 3) 3x A/B social tiles (square 1080x1080) with two headline variants each.

Reference: https://redwood.share/drive/webinar-ref (see slide 6 for tone).

Priority: funnel illustration > email hero > social tiles. Must be brand-compliant, accessible (WCAG AA), and deliver source Figma + flattened PNGs. Localization for EN/FR/DE (copy will be provided).

emma (design): Got it. Quick Qs — do we have final copy for all three languages? also which brand color token for CTA? can we reuse the micro-grid from last diagram? :thinking: 

ali (pm): I'll drop localized copy by tomorrow morning. CTA uses token --brand-accent-500. Reuse micro-grid ok if it doesn't conflict with the funnel layout.

sara (creative-ops): I'll create the tasks and tag assignees. Localization note: we'll need alt text for all images and a text-only fallback for email. Also confirm file naming: webinar_signup_<lang>_<asset>.

mike (growth): Heads-up — include final image URLs so we can pre-cache. Add UTM params: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar24_webinar. Also can we have 2 CTA color options to A/B test?

emma (design): Will mock CTA color alternatives. For accessibility: aiming for contrast ratio >=4.5:1 on text over color. Email hero: export @1x and @2x. Social tiles: include caption layer as separate export.

noah (mktg): Acceptance criteria: Figma link with frames for each deliverable, PNGs (flattened) + SVG for funnel diagram, Figma tokens not changed, include alt text spreadsheet, and a short 1-paragraph rationale for each A/B headline. Brand ops must sign off before assets go to staging.

brand-ops-bot: Reminder — tag #brand-approval and add the 'fast-track' label for this asset batch. Verify logos use primary lockup and that any photography uses vendor release.

sara (creative-ops): I'll queue brand review and set deadline Wed 5pm PT. Emma — can you drop first pass by Tue noon? If so I'll book brand review slot for Wed 10am.

emma (design): Yep — Tue noon first pass. Will upload Figma link when ready.

ali (pm): Copy variants (drop-in for designers):
```
EN:
- Subject A: 'How we cut inference costs 3x — live demo'
- Subject B: 'Reduce latency, save on GPU spend — join the live demo'
CTA variants: 'Register free' / 'Save my seat'

FR:
- Sujet A: 'Comment réduire de 3x le coût d'inférence — démo live'
- Sujet B: 'Réduisez la latence, économisez sur les GPU — participez'
CTA: 'S'inscrire' / 'Réserver ma place'

DE:
- Betreff A: 'Inference-Kosten 3x senken — Live-Demo'
- Betreff B: 'Latenz reduzieren, GPU-Kosten sparen — jetzt anmelden'
CTA: 'Jetzt registrieren' / 'Platz sichern'
```

mike (growth): Great — I'll wire up the UTM templates once images are final. If brand has any tweaks, ping me and I'll adapt tags.

noah (mktg): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
